answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent economies by tying identity weight to verifiable capital. Unlike a thin vine of influence, this bridge to economic consensus requires actors to lock assets, making identity fabrication prohibitively expensive. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake nodes must acquire significant copper or similar high-value tokens, ensuring the cost to subvert the protocol exceeds the potential gains from malicious consensus manipulation.
